title: Your first piece
goal: Play Ode to Joy all the way through, then look back at what you have learned.

steps.title: Ode to Joy
steps.text: A tune by Beethoven that has made people happy for 200 years. You know every skill it needs. First the tune with your right hand, then both hands.

steps.title: Right hand
steps.text: Play the whole tune. Thumb on E position: your fingers are on the lit keys.

steps.title: Both hands
steps.text: Now add the left hand underneath. Slow and steady.

steps.title: Check: play it in time
steps.text: The tune keeps time, a little slower than the real thing. Your timing score is on the next card.

steps.title: What you can do now
steps.text: Well done, you have finished the first ten lessons.
items: Find any key by its name
Use the right hand and the left hand
Keep a steady beat and count rests
steps.next: Next time: sharps and flats, more scales and chords.
